name: pointsman
description: Decision service: typed questions in, typed answers, probabilities and an action out.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-modules.mjs && node scripts/build-profiles.mjs && node scripts/build-openapi-validators.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build && wrangler types && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p test/worker/tsconfig.json && tsc -p test/bridge/tsconfig.json && pnpm check:core
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm validate:profiles && pnpm test:cases && pnpm check:public && pnpm deploy:dry-run
scripts.deploy:dry-run: pnpm build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config connectors/github/wrangler.jsonc --outdir .wrangler/dry-run-github
